transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. [Name]. To start, can you tell me what brings you in today?
I’m just so worn out. Even walking from the bedroom to the kitchen feels like hauling lumber all day, and resting doesn’t seem to give me anything back.
How long have you been feeling this level of exhaustion — days, weeks, or months?
About four months now. It started around when my wife went back to full-time work, and I was alone most weekdays.
Over these past four months, have you noticed a persistent low mood or a loss of interest and pleasure in things you used to enjoy?
Yeah. I wake up with this heavy, hopeless feeling in my chest. Some days I just sit out in the garage and cry, and I don’t even know what set it off.
Has your partner or anyone else noticed you snoring loudly or pausing in your breathing while you sleep?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been told that I snore or stop breathing in my sleep.
Have you noticed any unintentional weight gain or weight loss over these past four months?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed any clear change in my weight.
Have you noticed feeling unusually cold, having dry skin, or becoming more constipated than usual over these past few months?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed anything like that.
Have you ever had a similar period of low mood, low energy, and loss of interest in the past, before these last four months?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of another time like this before the last few months.
Have you noticed feeling short of breath, lightheaded, or unusually pale when you're active, even with mild exertion?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed that when I’m active.
After physical or mental effort, do you notice your exhaustion getting significantly worse for a day or more afterward, even after you rest?
Yes. Even something small, like walking from the bedroom to the kitchen, leaves me feeling like I hauled lumber all day. Resting doesn’t really give me anything back.
Aside from feeling tired, have you lost interest or pleasure in activities you used to enjoy, even on days when your energy is a bit better?
Yeah. I used to look forward to choir, pickup ball, working on cars, grilling for the family. Now I just... don’t care enough to go, or even answer people’s texts about it.
Over these past four months, have you had any thoughts that you're worthless, excessively guilty about things, or thoughts of death or hurting yourself?
Yeah... I keep thinking I should just be dead. When I’m alone, it scares me, because I start thinking I might actually do something to make that happen.
When you have these thoughts about wanting to be dead, have you thought about a specific way you might do it, or do you have access to any means to act on it?
I don’t have one specific way planned. But when I’m by myself, the thought keeps coming that I should just be dead, and it scares me because I feel like I might actually do something.

The presence of active, distressing suicidal ideation elevates severity to severe (F32.2) rather than moderate.
